plan: A little yordle who turns into a giant in fights and throws enemies into walls.
aSurveiller: His R (GNAR!). In giant form he knocks you back and stuns you against a wall: stay away from walls when he is angry.
contrer: Watch his rage bar: when it's full, he is about to transform.
Don't fight near walls against Mega Gnar: his R stuns you there.
Poke him in his small form: he is fragile.
forces: Very mobile in his small form.
faiblesses: Hard to manage; his transformation is easy to see coming.
Relies on walls for his R.

sorts.P: Turns into a giant when his rage is full.
sorts.Q: Boomerang that slows; boulder in his big form.
sorts.W: Bonus damage; stuns in his big form.
sorts.R: Knocks back and stuns against a wall.

momentFort: Strong in duels from the start, very useful in team fights.
